remarks:
Country Living, recreation, and room to roam await at 4755 Whaley Road! Set on 13 beautiful acres this property offers a wonderful combination of comfortable living space and outdoor enjoyment.
The home features 1714 square feet on the main level, plus additional finished space in the lower level that expands your living and entertaining possibilities with a recreation room, bar, half bath and separate mechanic's room and storage areas.
You will like the convenience of the First-floor laundry room, Primary bedroom and newly renovated bath! 
The spacious living room showcases cathedral ceilings, creating an inviting sense of openness and plenty of natural light from the large windows. 
Beautiful kitchen makes meal prep enjoyable with good counter space, abundant cabinet/pantry space and a comfortable space for informal dining. 
Step outside and enjoy your own private retreat with 13 acres of land including a stocked pond, wooded areas for hiking, exploring, hunting and enjoying the beauty of the surrounding countryside.
Although summer is over, you will have the two-tiered deck, awning, and above ground pool to look forward to after spending the Holidays and Winter months being cozy in your beautiful new home!
